thread:
jamie: Kicking off change window rollout for nginx-model-service v3.7.1 -> eu-west canaries (traffic shift 5%).
deploy-bot: Deploy started: v3.7.1 -> eu-west-canary (tasks queued). ETA ~6m. /deploy status: canary
sara: quick FYI — SLO dashboard (link) shows p95 spike on embeddings route already, small 5xx bump (~0.6%).
jamie: ugh, saw that too. can you paste the dashboard snapshot? pinging @mike
sara: here's the short graph: p95 latency jumped from 120ms -> 420ms over last 2 mins. 5xx went 0.02% -> 0.6% on embeddings-eu
mike: thanks. holding here. do not shift more traffic. can we scope to model-quantized endpoint only? :warning:
jamie: rolling hold. deploy-bot, pause traffic shift.
deploy-bot: Traffic shift paused at 5%. All further steps halted until manual resume. (reason: manual hold by jamie)
anya: digging through service logs — lots of backend KVCache timeouts and a queue backlog on the worker pool, looks correlated with larger sequences in recent test set.
mike: sounds like a degrad due to longer seqs hitting an edge-case kernel. propose pin to previous stable v3.7.0 for embeddings route until we investigate. @jamie ok to pin?
jamie: agree. pin embeddings route back to v3.7.0 and continue canary for other routes if safe. release notes update: note rollback/pin for embeddings in eu-west.
anya: running quick healthcheck on v3.7.0: all green locally.
jamie: deploy-bot run pin command please
deploy-bot: Executing: ``/deploy pin --service nginx-model-service --route embeddings-eu --version v3.7.0 --reason "5xx/p95 spike during change window"``
deploy-bot: Pin succeeded. embeddings-eu => v3.7.0. Confirmed by routing table.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-0482 — embeddings-eu elevated error-rate during rollout. Severity: P2. Assigned to: anya, sara.
sara: updated release notes snippet and PR: "Pause: embeddings route pinned to v3.7.0 in eu-west due to latency/5xx spike during change window. Investigating KVCache GC & worker queue." link_to_pr
mike: good triage. next: run a post-pin smokecheck on latency & error budget burn over the next 10m, then decide resume/rollback full release.
anya: smokecheck started. pushing a small synthetic load to embeddings-eu.
(3m later)
anya: smokecheck: p95 back to ~110ms, 5xx ~0.03%. error budget burn rate normalized.
jamie: ok looks stable. keep canary traffic paused for 15m while we dig deeper. no full rollout until root cause identified.
mike: opened follow-up task to reproduce with longer sequences + quantized kernel: TASK-457. include perf trace and kvcache metrics.
jamie: thanks team. I'll update the release channel and org-wide change window notes. moving to monitor + postmortem template once we have RCA.
sara: adding timeline and dashboards links to the incident. :thumbsup:
